scientific_integrity: Proof includes explicit cyclic gauge and prime-regular normalization, component minimality, and return subgroup. Brauer count is an established theorem, not a newly proved representation theorem.
scientific_limitations: Continuous finite-group cocycles over the single-prime p-adic adding machine only; classification under continuous principal-fibre gauges, not arbitrary topological conjugacy or Borel equivalence. The normalized classification is proved analytically; exact finite tests only supplement it. Prior work already gives odometer cocycle normal forms and the noncyclic minimal-extension obstruction. Historical bibliographic priority remains uncertain.
title: Prime-regular conjugacy classes classify finite-group cocycles over prime-adic odometers
